mechanism:
Inspect the current world and schedule to identify the 2 unfinished required navigation goals confirmed unreachable because of the no-go zone. Edit the scene tree so each affected goal, or the smallest unfinished containing assembly whose coherent relocation provides that goal, has a reachable destination outside the prohibited region. Preserve the relocated assembly's internal transforms and update all scene-tree-derived deposit and lift destinations consistently.

Required effect: after the edit, both previously unreachable required navigation goals are reachable by navigating agents without entering or weakening the no-go zone, so their nodes and all 12 frozen downstream nodes can close under the ordinary DAG frontier rule. The particular safe placements and whether individual unfinished destinations, containing sub-assemblies, or a larger unfinished build placement are translated are open implementation choices.

The tool does not edit, remove, or relax the no-go zone; does not move cargo through it; does not assign robots; and does not invoke or constrain the MILP re-solve. It consumes no scarce replacement body, though performing the intervention and subsequent travel incurs ordinary time and energy. Preconditions are that the affected work remains unfinished and that coherent reachable placements exist in the scene tree. The scene-tree edit can be undone before dependent physical placement work closes; after such work closes, reversal may require additional physical reconstruction and is not guaranteed.
impl_code:
function relocate_unreachable_delivery_geometry!(env)
    zone_keys = [first(zone) for zone in active_restriction_zones()]
    isempty(zone_keys) && error("No active restriction zone was found")

    restaged = restage_all_blocked!(env; zone_keys = zone_keys)
    restage_status = restaged.status

    blockage = zone_blockage(env; zone_keys = zone_keys, check_paths = true)
    if blockage.n_blocked != 0 || blockage.project_blocked
        translated = translate_whole_build!(env; zone_keys = zone_keys)
        translation_status = translated.status

        blockage = zone_blockage(env; zone_keys = zone_keys, check_paths = true)
        if blockage.n_blocked != 0 || blockage.project_blocked
            error("Scene-tree relocation left required navigation blocked (restage=$(restage_status), translation=$(translation_status), residual=$(blockage.n_blocked))")
        end
    end

    return (; status = :success)
end
